description: Reopen r-sort-3-keys-mdb (MDB) read-only. Reads stored values of LK (ID, K, N) and FR (ID, K, N, D) in ID order, then the ID sequence of SQL ORDER BY over LK for (K, N), (K DESC, N DESC), (K, N DESC), (N, K), (K, D), (K, M), (K, DT), (K, GU), over the incrementally built LK2 for (K, N), and over FR for seven key orders of mixed direction with Null, empty and marker-like values. Asks the public SQL order of the compound fixtures, kept apart from index traversal.
retentionNote: Designed r-sort-3 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
